attchmntText: Munjal Showa Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Munjal Showa Limited has published newspaper advertisements regarding its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in the English language newspaper Mint and the Hindi language newspaper Hindustan on November 14, 2026. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The information is also available on the company website at https://munjalshowa.net/investors/published-material/. The notice was signed by Ravinder Sharma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, with membership number A72077.

attchmntText: Munjal Showa Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Munjal Showa Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by statutory auditors Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 74,547.86 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at Rs. 1,382.96 lakhs. Profit after tax was Rs. 1,100.98 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 2.75. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were Rs. 90,699.16 lakhs. The Limited Review Report confirms no material misstatements were identified.
